name: photo-mosaic
title: Photo mosaic
description: The header gallery of a listing: one large photo, four small ones, and a Show all button on the last, collapsing to one photo on a phone.
docs: photos are { src, alt, label }; the first five are shown. total is the number of photos in all, when the gallery holds more than you pass. onOpen(index) is called with the place of the photo that was pressed and onShowAll when the button is, so you open your own lightbox or sheet: the mosaic opens nothing. Every cell is a button named 'Photo 3 of 24: Kitchen'. With fewer than five photos the layout falls back to one, two, three or four. Below about 32rem of its own width it shows the first photo with a '1 / 24' counter (none for a lone photo), and below 48rem the Show all button shrinks to its icon and the count so it never outgrows its cell, its name staying whole. labels and locale translate the names and the number.
